subject.title: feat: retain iMessage tombstones and revisions

question: Should normal `imsgcrawl sync` change from replacing the local archive to retaining absent rows by default, with replacement available only through `--restore`?
rationale: This is an upgrade-visible archive-retention policy that can intentionally preserve data users previously expected a normal sync to replace; tests cannot determine the desired product contract.

options.title: Keep replacement as default
options.body: Retain the established replacement behavior for `sync` and expose merge retention only through an explicit opt-in mode.

options.title: Approve merge by default
options.body: Accept the new preservation-first contract and require clear upgrade documentation plus real behavior proof for merge and restore paths.

recommendation.title: Keep replacement as default
recommendation.body: Retain the established replacement behavior for `sync` and expose merge retention only through an explicit opt-in mode.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows steipete carrying the implementation and follow-up fixes for this archive-sync proposal; repository approval remains a human product decision.
